text:
marta: heads-up — after today's runtime merge (commit 53f4c2a) our short-sequence canary p95 doubled. decode tail +~200ms, throughput down. canary blocked. :eyes:
ci-bot: PERF CANARY FAILED: job/runtime-canary/3319994321 — p95 decode +210ms vs baseline. dashboard: https://ci.redwood/inference/canaries/3319994321 :warning:
sunil: any traces or quick profiles attached?
marta: attaching a quick perf snap i captured on canary node — flamegraph link and perf-top snippet. high time spent in fused_attn_v2 and a lot of memcpy in kv eviction path. snippet:
```
fused_attn_v2                45%
kv_cache_eviction_memcpy     18%
decoder_kernel_dispatch      12%
```
devon: hmm fused_attn_v2 should be faster than v1. could the kernel selector be picking a fallback path incorrectly under KV-warm conditions? also smart-batcher heuristics changed in the merge. did you repro locally?
marta: repros on my devbox with runtime:canary-53f4. repro command: `pytest -k shortseq_perf --perf --rps 50` — shows the same p95 spike. GPU util lower than baseline (weird) which suggests suboptimal kernel choice, not congestion.
xia: saw a related slack thread earlier — smart-batcher's max_window logic expands microbatch windows when kv hit-rate spikes, which increases memory pressure. that plus async-kv-serializer refactor might be causing buffers to linger.
eden: ci logs show host memory growing and repeated kernel re-registration warnings. relevant log excerpts:
```
[WARN] kernel_selector: switching kernel from fused_attn_v1 -> fused_attn_v2 (reason: seq_len>256, kv_hit_rate>0.6)
[ERROR] kv_serializer: async buffer never freed for session 0x7f2a
```
devon: ok can we bisect the merge range? I can run binary bisection across the last few merges. @marta can you run the bisect helper (scripts/ci/bisect_perf.sh) against canary image?
marta: starting bisection now over range 53d0..5400. will post results in ~20m. pinned production to image 52d1 for now. rollout paused.
ci-bot: NOTE: runtime rollout paused by ops. canary jobs in blocked state.
(20m later)
marta: bisection result — blame narrowed to commit 53f4c2a (kernel-selector: add prefer_high_throughput flag; changed selection thresholds). reverting that commit locally restores baseline p95.
sunil: that aligns — the new threshold biases toward high-throughput kernels (fused_attn_v2) even when kv cache is warm; fused_attn_v2 has a regression on kv-warm codepath.
devon: repro case I used: loop of short requests with kv cache warm, microbatch pattern [1,1,1,8]. p95 jumps when selector flips to fused_attn_v2. workaround: export KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy or set REDWOOD_SMART_BATCHER_MAX_WINDOW=1 — both bring p95 back.
marta: opened PR to revert 53f4c2a — PR #2489 (revert kernel-selector threshold). added perf-suite regression reproducer and a failing test that demonstrates the flip. marking as rollout-blocker.
xia: i'll draft a short hotfix in kernel_selector: if kv_hit_rate > 0.5 prefer low_mem kernel until we have a safe fused_attn_v2 patch. small change, low-risk.
eden: also adding ticket to investigate async-kv-serializer buffer free path — logs show leaked buffers when sessions churn. could be a separate leak introduced by earlier refactor.
devon: taking ownership of the leak triage. suspect race in buffer pool free introduced in commit 52f7. will run address sanitizer on serializer and capture allocation traces.
ci-bot: triggered canary run for revert PR #2489 — job/runtime-canary/3319994345. link: https://ci.redwood/inference/jobs/3319994345 :rocket:
marta: thanks. if revert passes canary we'll roll revert to prod and follow up with a targeted patch for fused_attn_v2 and serializer fix.
sunil: good plan. postmortem items: (1) expand perf-suite with kv-warm short-seq scenarios, (2) add kernel-selector unit tests covering kv_hit_rate and batching window interactions, (3) add telemetry to surface kernel switches per-session.
marta: assigning follow-ups: devon -> async-kv-serializer leak + alloc traces; xia -> hotfix kernel-selector guard; sunil -> add perf-suite tests; i'll own PR/revert and rollout.
devon: will update this thread with ASAN logs and a minimal repro binary. ETA EOD.
marta: thanks all — marking thread as rollout-blocker until revert canary completes. :thumbsup: Will sync in the 11:30 stand if canary still flapping.
